introHeading: A branded booth built for Queens' biggest rooms
introParas: Queens throws the biggest guest lists we see all year, and a branded booth here has to be built for volume rather than a slow trickle of guests. Long Island City's newer event spaces give a full booth wrap real ceiling height to work with, and catering halls in Astoria, Flushing and Forest Hills routinely run past a thousand attendees — which changes how you plan a brand activation. Unlimited sessions and a print system built to keep pace mean the branded booth does not become the bottleneck at the biggest room you book all season.

That scale is exactly where the opt-in data capture pays off. Surveys and questionnaires run in-flow, so a brand with a genuinely large Queens audience collects feedback from hundreds of attendees rather than the handful who would fill out a form at a table, and every opt-in adds to a compliant list your marketing team can remarket to. The full wrap, custom start screen and branded overlays keep that consistent across a company party, a retail activation or a sponsorship deal, so every printed and shared photo reads as one campaign rather than a booth someone rented on the side.

For venues where the guest count outruns a single line, we can pair the branded booth with a roaming attendant so coverage extends to the tables and the bar, not just whoever queues. Footprint stays the same as anywhere else we work — 10ft x 10ft optimal, 8ft x 8ft the minimum, a dedicated 110V outlet within 15 feet — and Queens is a standard service area with no surprise travel fees, quoted from your venue ZIP code before you book.

faqHeading: Branded Photo Booth in Queens — FAQ

faqs.q: Can the branded booth keep up with a large Queens catering hall?
faqs.a: Yes — unlimited sessions and a fast print system are built for exactly that. For guest counts that outrun a single line, we can also pair the booth with a roaming attendant so coverage reaches the tables, not just whoever is queuing.

faqs.q: How far in advance do you need our brand assets?
faqs.a: Two to three weeks is comfortable for a full printed wrap. Digital-only branding — start screen, overlays, the online gallery — can be turned around faster if your event date is closer.

faqs.q: Do we own the photos and the opt-in data from our Queens event?
faqs.a: Yes. The images and any opt-in contact data collected belong to you. We provide the branded gallery and a report of what was captured; what you do with them afterward is your call.

faqs.q: Which Queens venues have you set up the branded booth in?
faqs.a: Catering halls in Astoria, Flushing and Forest Hills, and newer event spaces in Long Island City with the ceiling height a full wrap needs to read well in photos. Send us your venue name and we will confirm the exact fit before you book.

faqs.q: Is there a travel fee for a branded booth in Queens?
faqs.a: Queens is a standard service area with no surprise fees. We quote travel from your venue ZIP code before you book, so there is nothing to discover on the invoice afterward.

faqs.q: How much does a branded photo booth rental cost in Queens?
faqs.a: Pricing depends on the hours you need and how much of the booth is branded. Every quote is built for your specific event rather than pulled off a rate card; the quote form returns a real number in about 30 seconds. Additional hours beyond your booked time are $125 per hour.

faqs.q: How much space and power does the branded booth need?
faqs.a: Optimal setup is 10ft x 10ft, which leaves room for the wrapped booth, a props table and a branded backdrop. We can compress to 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance when a room is tight. We need a standard 110V, 5-amp, 3-prong outlet within 15 feet of the booth.

faqs.q: Do you carry insurance and provide a COI for Queens venues?
faqs.a: Yes. We carry a $2 million insurance policy. If your Queens venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.
